teaser: Carol Stein debuts at Casey's Corner piano today; EPCOT's 2027 Festival of the Arts dates revealed; Oktoberfest banners up at Biergarten.

bignews.title: Carol Stein takes piano at Casey's Corner
bignews.body: A 36-year Disney veteran known as the Hat Lady is now performing outside Casey's Corner on Main Street U.S.A. Carol Stein brings decades of musical experience to the iconic piano spot.

parkioInsight.text: Main Street tends to draw crowds for live entertainment. Catching Carol's set early morning or during parade hours usually offers the best viewing spots and atmosphere.

bignews.title: EPCOT's 2027 Festival of the Arts dates announced
bignews.body: The Festival of the Arts returns January 10 through February 23, 2027, with visual arts, culinary displays, and performing arts throughout the park. Disney Lorcana Trading Card Game returns as presenting sponsor.

parkioInsight.text: Festival weekdays in January tend to be quieter than February weekends. Booking accommodations now for mid-January often locks in lower rates before spring break bookings surge.

bignews.title: Flower and Garden Festival 2027 dates set
bignews.body: EPCOT's Flower and Garden Festival will run March 10 through May 31, 2027, featuring character topiaries, outdoor kitchens, and garden displays across the park.

parkioInsight.text: March weekdays typically offer shorter wait times than April spring break weeks. Early entry often provides the best window for attraction rides before outdoor kitchen lines build mid-morning.

bignews.title: Disney After Hours 2027 tickets now available
bignews.body: After Hours events return to Magic Kingdom, Hollywood Studios, and Animal Kingdom in 2027. Tickets are on sale now for the separately ticketed nighttime events with shorter wait times.

parkioInsight.text: After Hours events usually see the lowest waits during the final 90 minutes before close. Arriving right at event start often means competing with day guests still exiting the park.

topstories.title: Oktoberfest banners installed at Biergarten
topstories.body: New colorful banners celebrating Oktoberfest now line the walkway and entrance to Biergarten Restaurant in EPCOT's Germany Pavilion. The restaurant serves Oktoberfest-themed buffet year-round.

parkioInsight.text: Biergarten tends to fill up for dinner service during festival season. Lunch reservations or walk-up attempts between 2–4pm often have better availability than prime evening slots.

topstories.title: Hispanic and Latin American Heritage Month underway
topstories.body: Together We Are Magia runs through October 15 at Walt Disney World, celebrating Hispanic and Latin American Heritage Month with special experiences, music, and cultural programming across the resort.

parkioInsight.text: Cultural entertainment and special menu items are usually available throughout the month. Checking the Times Guide daily often reveals limited-time performances that aren't heavily advertised in advance.

topstories.title: Guardians of the Galaxy September 21 event returns
topstories.body: September 21 marks the annual all-day celebration at Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind when EPCOT runs the same fan-favorite song on repeat instead of the randomized six-track playlist.

parkioInsight.text: September 21 tends to draw dedicated fans seeking the single-song experience. Standby waits often spike above 90 minutes by mid-morning; rope drop or late evening usually offer the shortest queues.

topstories.title: New Bluey plush charms and car magnet arrive
topstories.body: Chilli and Rusty plush bag charms plus a Heeler family car magnet are now available at Walt Disney World retail locations, expanding the resort's Bluey merchandise collection.

parkioInsight.text: Popular character merchandise tends to sell out quickly at flagship stores. Checking World of Disney or park emporiums early in your visit often yields better stock than waiting until departure day.

topstories.title: Disney launches AI-powered vacation planning tools
topstories.body: Walt Disney World is beta testing new artificial intelligence features on its website, including flexible search for lowest room rates, pricing calendars, resort comparison tools, and AI planning assistance.

parkioInsight.text: Flexible date searches may uncover midweek discounts that fixed-date searches miss. Checking multiple arrival dates in the new tool often reveals savings of 20 percent or more for the same resort tier.

topstories.title: Water Park Seasonal Pass returns for 2027
topstories.body: Walt Disney World brought back the discounted Water Park Seasonal Pass for Typhoon Lagoon and Blizzard Beach, covering visits now through mid-2027 at a reduced price compared to standard admission.

parkioInsight.text: Seasonal passes typically pay for themselves after three visits. If you're planning multiple water park days or extended stays, purchasing early often locks in the current rate before any future price adjustments.

topstories.title: Holiday resort discount deadline approaching
topstories.body: Disney's fall and holiday resort discount covering stays through Christmas is currently available, but booking windows may close as rooms fill. The offer applies to select resort categories and dates.

parkioInsight.text: Holiday discounts tend to disappear as inventory tightens, often weeks before the travel window. Locking in a reservation now with free cancellation usually protects your rate even if better offers appear later.

icymi.title: Logo Mania merchandise collection launched
icymi.body: A new colorful Logo Mania collection featuring attraction, land, and transportation logos is now available at Disney Parks, offering six design themes celebrating favorite park elements.

icymi.title: Halloween merchandise collections expanding
icymi.body: New Halloween items from Crowned Athletics and additional seasonal collections are rolling out across Disney Parks, adding to the growing selection of spooky merchandise for fall.

icymi.title: Trader Sam's Enchanted Tiki Bar remains open during construction
icymi.body: The popular Disneyland bar is undergoing construction work but continues to serve guests. The venue remains operational despite ongoing updates to the space.

icymi.title: Aulani room discount up to 25 percent available
icymi.body: A new promotion offers up to 25 percent off rooms at Disney's Aulani Resort in Hawaii for select travel dates, providing savings for guests planning a Hawaii vacation.

spotlight.title: Catch Carol Stein's Casey's Corner debut this week
spotlight.body: The longtime Disney performer known for her signature hats is now bringing her piano artistry to Main Street U.S.A. after more than three decades with the company. Her addition continues the beloved tradition of live music at the hot dog landmark, offering guests a memorable soundtrack to their Magic Kingdom visit.

parkioInsight.text: Live piano performances tend to draw crowds during peak lunch and dinner hours. Stopping by mid-afternoon or late morning often provides a quieter moment to enjoy the music and grab a seat nearby.
